slot.brief: Single-blank sentence with a straightforward contextual clue pointing to a common word; options are everyday-level vocabulary.

stem: The roads were blocked by fallen trees, so the rescue team had to take a ______ route to reach the village.

verdicts.working: Blocked roads require an alternative route; “different” fits the context.

working:
Blocked roads require the team to take a route that is not the usual one; “different” fits. “Careless,” “ordinary,” and “silent” do not express this meaning.

Independent check: Blocked roads require an alternative route; “different” fits the context.
solution: Blocked roads make the usual route unusable, so the team must take a route that is not the same as usual. “Different” fits this meaning.
